ci_formula: paired_bb[d] = (hero_net_chips_half1[d] + hero_net_chips_half2[d]) / big_blind; mean = sum(paired_bb)/n; SE = sample_stdev(paired_bb, ddof=1)/sqrt(n); CI = mean ± 1.96*SE. n = deals. This is the judge's paired-deal interval, not an interval on independent single hands.

rerank_benchmark.note: Extra cost of recomputing street strength on the combined pool instead of only the new batch.
